items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: John C. Smith, trumpet player, he played at all the society clubs around New York

ctx.x: Played a lot like them bands I was telling you about, like John C. Smith and Happy Roane Wilhelm. The salary sound, it was good. I mean you get a bunch of one nighters, you could take a whole week sometime.
Well, that really would account for that, and then if you can play pretty, that would be very nice in there.
